governing_outcome: Every mutation and every durable read/create/update/delete/output/migration asset must be governed through one persistent-asset model so GitHub/Library/Notion/Drive/chat/Memory/Custom Instructions/automations cannot silently become competing current control planes after migration, while ephemeral mutations remain possible without fake persistent assets and ambiguous side effects cannot be mistaken for clean failure.
raw_evidence: Financial Writing migrated to GitHub but Library still contained an ACTIVE_POINTER with retired topology references until this audit.
Google Drive legacy continuity documents were already inside a legacy archive folder but retained current-looking Router/State/System Policy/Handoff names and remained globally searchable.
Notion retained an old CURRENT_CHAT_HANDOFF, PENDING_REVIEWQUEUE and migrated writing regression records alongside reusable ArticleBase/IndustryBase knowledge.
A Library-wide search also found an ACTIVE_POINTER to the retired universal-continuity-agent; it was decommissioned and moved to UAOS_Migrated_History.

UAOS RETRIEVAL_POLICY governed repository retrieval and AUTHORITY_WRITE_POLICY governed authority scope/mutation, but production had no common cross-surface asset lifecycle/CRUD/output classification model.

During this audit the acting controller mis-sequenced GitHub candidate targeting and briefly created a placeholder on main before immediately reverting it. This is direct dogfood evidence that model intention plus prose policy is insufficient mutation admission.
professional_method_evidence: Accellera UVM register abstraction supports multiple physical access paths behind one abstract model and warns that mirrors become stale when changes occur outside observed paths.
UVM explicit prediction uses monitors/predictors to observe operations from all access paths rather than trusting only model-originated writes.

Selected analogy: persistent-surface governance requires one abstract asset model, adapter-owned canonical addressing, observed side effects, and reconciliation; a search hit or stale mirror is not authority.

architecture_candidates.reason: Residual active-looking assets and the self-dogfood direct-main incident falsify reliance on naming conventions/model discipline.
Would clean one domain but preserve the common failure class for every other Agent and future migration.
Creates more shadow authorities and drift.
Codex found READ/DELETE spoofing, descriptor relabeling and target-alias bypasses; caller assertions cannot be trusted execution semantics.
A legitimate UNKNOWN execution id could be paired with forged provider_ref/output/evidence and redirect a reconciler; reconciliation truth must remain coordinator-owned.
Two threads could enter provider reconciliation for the same opaque execution id and duplicate repair side effects; per-execution reconciliation must be single-flight.
Would incorrectly force in-memory/session-local side effects to fabricate durable assets.
Existence/inode checks do not serialize same-inode writes or make expected-hash validation atomic with replacement.
Creates a transient production state in which merged behavior is active while persisted policy/evolution metadata is still candidate or promotion-pending.

Reuses the existing mutation sentinel while separating action semantics, physical target identity, asset lifecycle ownership, UNKNOWN reconciliation truth and claim state, local cooperative concurrency and production-ref activation without a second control plane or post-merge rewrite.

falsification_and_review_evidence: Independent Codex review found caller READ spoofing, action/CRUD mismatch, descriptor-target mismatch, untrusted owner/lifecycle relabeling, path-alias bypass, missing reconciliation mediation, unused migration closure, weak migration target binding, candidate/activation mismatch and overblocking of ephemeral side effects.

Later adversarial review found caller side_effect_class spoofing, approval downgrade during reconciliation, capability re-registration substitution, string disposition migration bypass, local create-vs-update effect mismatch and string-enum catalog bypass.

Filesystem adversarial review found CREATE check-then-replace and parent symlink race risks; local workspace mutation was redesigned around dirfd/O_NOFOLLOW traversal, atomic CREATE no-replace and bound-parent atomic UPDATE rename.

Final adversarial review found three remaining trust/commit gaps: caller-forgeable UNKNOWN outcome fields, expected-hash UPDATE without a serialized check+commit critical section, and FAILED returned after a filesystem commit point when cleanup/fsync failed.

Those findings were repaired by coordinator-owned opaque UNKNOWN records, advisory parent-directory flock plus final hash recheck for cooperating UAOS writers, and explicit UNKNOWN after link/rename commit-point uncertainty.

Concurrency replay then falsified the first opaque-record design: two concurrent callers could resolve the same UNKNOWN execution id and both enter the provider reconciler. The coordinator now claims each execution id single-flight before any reconciliation side effect.

Production-state adversarial review found that a descriptive production_status_after_merge string could not materialize ACTIVE state; promotion was redesigned as executable trusted-ref-conditioned activation.
The candidate was redesigned at each layer rather than preserving caller-label, caller-receipt, unclaimed-reconciliation, path-check or post-merge-rewrite assumptions.
external_surface_remediation: Library Financial ACTIVE_POINTER replaced by authority-NONE tombstone and moved to Financial_Writing_Migrated_History; casebook marked MIGRATED_HISTORY.
Global Library Continuity ACTIVE_POINTER to retired controller decommissioned and moved to UAOS_Migrated_History.
Drive legacy Router/State/System Policy/Handoff/Conflicts names explicitly marked DECOMMISSIONED LEGACY inside legacy archive.
Notion old Financial Review Queue and CURRENT_CHAT_HANDOFF renamed MIGRATED_HISTORY/DECOMMISSIONED; ArticleBase/IndustryBase retained as non-authority shared knowledge.
acceptance_criteria: Every supported capability action is explicitly classified read-only or mutating at trusted registration; caller side_effect_class cannot downgrade mutability.
Every mutating capability action has a trusted EPHEMERAL or DURABLE_OR_EXTERNAL contract or fails closed.
Durable/external CRUD is derived from trusted capability registration, not request labels, and CREATE/UPDATE are distinct where the real executor effect differs.
Durable/external target identity is adapter-canonicalized before trusted asset lookup.
Role/lifecycle/owner/allowed operations come from a normalized trusted asset catalog and cannot be caller-relabeled.
Ephemeral mutation works without fabricating a persistent asset.

UNKNOWN reconciliation is selected only by an opaque coordinator-issued execution id and uses the coordinator-owned original request, admission and normalized UNKNOWN outcome; caller-returned UNKNOWN fields cannot redirect reconciliation.
Exactly one reconciliation attempt may hold the claim for an UNKNOWN execution id at a time; concurrent attempts fail closed before provider repair side effects.
Reconciliation remains bound to the original capability registration generation and reruns authority/persistent/approval gates.
Migration cannot return CONFIRMED without normalized disposition and identity-bound verified-target/source-retirement closure evidence.
Local workspace CREATE is atomic no-replace and local path traversal is pinned to no-follow directory descriptors.

Local expected-hash UPDATE serializes cooperating UAOS writers with an advisory parent-directory lock, rechecks content before atomic rename and does not claim hostile external-writer linearizability.
A local filesystem mutation that crosses link/rename commit point but cannot confirm cleanup/directory durability returns UNKNOWN rather than FAILED.
Non-authority surfaces cannot be promoted to current business authority by search presence, memory relevance or stale bootstrap text.
Financial declares exactly one current business authority and classifies the other persistent surfaces without copying parent policy.
The same validated policy tree resolves non-active on candidate refs and ACTIVE_EXECUTION_POLICY only on trusted D1traverser-debug/universal-agent-os main.
Native ChatGPT product-internal chat/memory/Custom Instructions physical mediation is not claimed.
known_boundary: Repository-controlled UAOS can mechanically enforce trusted mutation admission only on controlled execution paths. Native ChatGPT product-internal chat, Memory and Custom Instructions are behaviorally classified and connector-observed where possible, but no repository-controlled physical interception is claimed. ActionCoordinator's baseline UNKNOWN reconciliation record and single-flight claim are process-local and fail closed after coordinator restart; a host requiring cross-process reconciliation must persist the same authoritative record and atomic claim state. External filesystem writers that ignore advisory locks remain outside UAOS complete-mediation and linearizability assurance; local dirfd/no-follow, final hash recheck and atomic commit defenses reduce races without claiming hostile-system-wide serialization.
